about.title: About This Application
about.conceptBody: Collect a deep-sea creature each day, explore virtual Numazu, and share a postcard of your discovery.
about.operatorName: Umimachi Lab Numazu (うみまちラボ沼津)
about.operatorBody: Umimachi Lab Numazu is a local project documenting and sharing the coastal lifestyle, marine culture, and regional character around Numazu and Suruga Bay.
about.disclaimerItem1: Draws, collections and exploration are virtual experiences. Real-world visits are not recorded.
about.disclaimerItem2: Interest, collection and discovery records stay on this device. There are no shared counts or rankings.
about.disclaimerItem3: In-app Rank (★1–★5) represents draw probability weights only and does not indicate biological rarity or conservation status.
about.dataPolicyBody: Species information is compiled from verified public research institutes, aquariums, and tourism associations. Catalog progress and preferences are saved locally in your browser (localStorage) without sending personal data to external servers.
